title: STONK enters correction phase after $0.35 ATH – Weekly gains cut to 12%
summary: Decoding why StonkFun's rally had cooled off over the past four days.
content: STONK has entered a correction phase following its recent all-time high of $0.35, which has significantly reduced its weekly gains to 12 percent. This cooling off period comes after a strong rally over the past four days, according to recent market tracking data for the token.
content_ta: STONK தனது சமீபத்திய ஆல்-டைம் ஹை விலையான $0.35-ஐ எட்டிய பிறகு திருத்தக் கட்டத்திற்குள் (correction phase) நுழைந்துள்ளது. இதனால் அதன் வாராந்திர லாபம் 12 சதவீதமாகக் குறைந்துள்ளது. கடந்த நான்கு நாட்களாகத் தொடர்ந்து வந்த உயர்வுக்குப் பிறகு சந்தையில் இந்தச் சரிவு ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: ConnectPay spins off core banking technology as independent product
summary: Lithuanian fintech ConnectPay has spun off its inhouse AWS-native core banking platform, Serdis, as an independent commercial offering for EMIs and financial institutions.
content: Lithuanian fintech ConnectPay has spun off its in-house core banking technology, known as Serdis, into an independent commercial product. Originally built on AWS for internal operations, the cloud-native platform is now being offered as a standalone solution to electronic money institutions and other financial organizations seeking scalable infrastructure for their digital banking needs.
content_ta: லித்துவேனியாவைச் சேர்ந்த fintech நிறுவனமான ConnectPay, தனது சொந்த core banking தொழில்நுட்பமான Serdis-ஐ ஒரு தனித்த வணிக தயாரிப்பாகப் பிரித்து வழங்கியுள்ளது. AWS-ஐ அடிப்படையாகக் கொண்டு உள்நாட்டுப் பயன்பாட்டிற்காக உருவாக்கப்பட்ட இந்த கிளவுட்-சார்ந்த தளம், தற்போது EMIs மற்றும் பிற நிதி நிறுவனங்களுக்குத் தனித்தீர்வாக வழங்கப்படுகிறது.

title: Circle, Ripple and Visa join $10 funding round for stablecoin platform Velocity
summary: UK stablecoin startup Velocity has raised $10 million in an extension of its Series A round, with investment from Visa Ventures, Circle Ventures, Ripple, Haun Ventures, Translink Capital and Mirana Ventures.
content: UK stablecoin startup Velocity has raised $10 million in an extension of its Series A funding round. The investment saw participation from major industry players including Visa Ventures, Circle Ventures, Ripple, Haun Ventures, Translink Capital, and Mirana Ventures. The company focuses on the stablecoin platform sector.
content_ta: UK-ஐ சேர்ந்த stablecoin நிறுவனமான Velocity, தனது Series A ஃபண்டிங் ரவுண்டின் நீட்சியாக 10 மில்லியன் டாலர் நிதியை திரட்டியுள்ளது. இந்த முதலீட்டில் Visa Ventures, Circle Ventures, Ripple, Haun Ventures, Translink Capital மற்றும் Mirana Ventures போன்ற முக்கிய நிறுவனங்கள் பங்கேற்றுள்ளன.

title: Payments infrastructure startup Fin.com emerges from stealth with $20m funding
summary: Fin.com, a financial infrastructure company building an orchestration layer that lets businesses collect, convert, and move money across borders through local payment rails, USD virtual accounts, Swift and stablecoin settlement, has emerged from stealth with $20 million in funding.
content: Payments infrastructure startup Fin.com has officially emerged from stealth mode, securing $20 million in funding. The company is building an advanced orchestration layer designed to help businesses seamlessly collect, convert, and move money across international borders. Its platform leverages local payment rails, USD virtual accounts, Swift, and stablecoin settlement to simplify global financial operations for modern enterprises.
content_ta: பெமண்ட்ஸ் இன்ஃப்ராஸ்ட்ரக்சர் ஸ்டார்ட்அப் நிறுவனமான Fin.com, இருபது மில்லியன் டாலர் நிதியுதவியுடன் தனது மறைமுக நிலையிலிருந்து அதிகாரப்பூர்வமாக வெளிவந்துள்ளது. வணிகங்கள் சர்வதேச எல்லைகள் முழுவதும் பணத்தைச் சேகரிக்கவும், மாற்றவும், நகர்த்தவும் உதவும் மேம்பட்ட ஒருங்கிணைப்பு அப்பட்டத்தை இந்நிறுவனம் உருவாக்கி வருகிறது. நவீன நிறுவனங்களின் உலகளாவிய நிதிச் செயல்பாடுகளை எளிதாக்க, இந்த தளம் உள்ளூர் கட்டண முறைகள், USD விர்ச்சுவல் கணக்குகள், Swift மற்றும் stablecoin செட்டில்மென்ட் ஆகியவற்றைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.

title: Crypto industry turns to US regulators after CLARITY setback
summary: The CLARITY Act could still be revived after Senator Thom Tillis moved to reconsider the failed cloture vote, though industry executives are divided over whether Congress has enough time left.
content: The cryptocurrency industry is shifting its focus back to US regulators following a legislative setback with the CLARITY Act. While Senator Thom Tillis has moved to reconsider a failed cloture vote, offering a glimmer of hope for revival, industry executives remain deeply divided over whether Congress has sufficient time remaining to pass the legislation.
content_ta: CLARITY Act விவகாரத்தில் ஏற்பட்ட பின்னடைவைத் தொடர்ந்து, கிரிப்டோகரன்சி துறை மீண்டும் US ரெகுலேட்டர்களின் பக்கம் தனது கவனத்தைத் திருப்பியுள்ளது. Senator Thom Tillis தோல்வியடைந்த cloture வாக்கெடுப்பை மறுபரிசீலனை செய்ய நடவடிக்கை எடுத்துள்ளதால் மசோதா மீதான நம்பிக்கை நீடித்தாலும், காங்கிரஸ் அவகாசம் போதுமானதாக இருக்குமா என்பதில் துறைசார் தலைவர்கள் மத்தியில் கருத்து வேறுபாடு நிலவுகிறது.

title: Ripple’s university strategy is evolving from blockchain labs to XRP logos in packed stadiums
summary:
The 69-day rollout spans Kansas uniforms, Florida’s football field and Louisville basketball, but stops short of token adoption.
The post Ripple’s university strategy is evolving from blockchain labs to XRP logos in packed stadiums appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: Ripple is shifting its university strategy away from traditional blockchain labs toward high-visibility sports sponsorships featuring XRP logos in packed stadiums. The rollout includes branding on team uniforms and playing fields across multiple universities, though the partnerships currently stop short of actual token adoption.
content_ta: Ripple தனது பல்கலைக்கழக உத்தியை பாரம்பரிய பிளாக்செயின் ஆய்வகங்களிலிருந்து மாற்றி, மைதானங்களில் XRP லோகோக்களைக் கொண்ட விளையாட்டு ஸ்பான்சர்ஷிப்களில் கவனம் செலுத்துகிறது. இந்தத் திட்டத்தின் கீழ் பல்வேறு பல்கலைக்கழகங்களின் சீருடைகள் மற்றும் விளையாட்டு மைதானங்களில் பிராண்டிங் செய்யப்படுகிறது, எனினும் இப்போதைக்கு டோக்கன் பயன்பாடு இதில் இல்லை.

title: Congress wants to make crypto easier to use and still collect $500 million more in taxes
summary:
H.R. 10357 would ease payments, fees and qualifying loans while widening loss-deferral and trader-accounting rules.
The post Congress wants to make crypto easier to use and still collect $500 million more in taxes appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: A new congressional bill, H.R. 10357, aims to simplify cryptocurrency use by easing payments, transaction fees, and qualifying loans. At the same time, the proposed legislation seeks to broaden loss-deferral and trader-accounting rules, with the goal of generating an estimated $500 million in additional tax revenue.
content_ta: புதிய காங்கிரஸ் மசோதாவான H.R. 10357, crypto பயன்பாட்டை எளிதாக்குவதையும், கட்டணங்கள் மற்றும் தகுதியான கடன்களைத் தளர்த்துவதையும் நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது. அதே நேரத்தில், இந்த முன்மொழியப்பட்ட சட்டம் கூடுதல் வரி வருவாயாக 500 மில்லியன் டாலர்களை ஈட்டும் இலக்குடன் நஷ்ட ஒத்திவைப்பு மற்றும் வர்த்தக கணக்கியல் விதிகளை விரிவுபடுத்த முயல்கிறது.

title: World Liberty Financial: Can $6M in whale buying help WLFI reclaim $0.06?
summary: A World Liberty Financial whale purchased 108 million WLFI worth $6.18 million
content: A major cryptocurrency whale has purchased 108 million WLFI tokens through World Liberty Financial, with the total transaction valued at approximately $6.18 million. Market observers are now watching to see if this significant accumulation can help the asset regain upward momentum and reclaim the $0.06 price level following recent market movements.
content_ta: World Liberty Financial-ல் ஒரு பெரிய cryptocurrency whale, 108 மில்லியன் WLFI டோக்கன்களை வாங்கியுள்ளது. இந்த மொத்த பரிவர்த்தனையின் மதிப்பு தோராயமாக $6.18 மில்லியன் ஆகும். இந்த குறிப்பிடத்தக்க முதலீடு WLFI-ன் விலையை மீண்டும் $0.06 என்ற நிலைக்கு கொண்டு செல்ல உதவுமா என்பதை சந்தை பார்வையாளர்கள் உன்னிப்பாக கவனித்து வருகின்றனர்.

title: $420 mln vanished: How Poland’s Venezuelan oil deal exposed USDT loopholes
summary: The oil was never arrived, tankers sat idle, but hundreds of millions were converted into USDT.
content: A high-profile Venezuelan oil deal involving Poland resulted in hundreds of millions of dollars vanishing. Hundreds of millions were converted into USDT as part of the transaction, but the oil never arrived and tankers remained idle. This incident has exposed significant loopholes in the use of USDT for international trade and financial transactions.
content_ta: போலந்து நாட்டைச் சார்ந்த வெனிசுலா எண்ணெய் வர்த்தக ஒப்பந்தம் ஒன்றில் கோடிக்கணக்கான டாலர்கள் மாயமான விவகாரம் பெரும் சர்ச்சையை ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த வர்த்தகத்தின் ஒரு பகுதியாகப் பல நூறு மில்லியன் கணக்கான டாலர்கள் USDT-ஆக மாற்றப்பட்டன. ஆனால், எண்ணெய் டெலிவரி செய்யப்படாமல் கப்பல்கள் தேங்கிக் கிடந்தன. இந்தச் சம்பவம் USDT பரிவர்த்தகங்களில் உள்ள முக்கிய ஓட்டைகளை வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டியுள்ளது.

title: White House Adviser Phelan Warns Fed Rate Hike Today Would Be a Mistake
summary:
CEA Chairman Christopher Phelan says a Fed rate hike this week would be a mistake, citing falling inflation data.
The post White House Adviser Phelan Warns Fed Rate Hike Today Would Be a Mistake appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: White House Council of Economic Advisers Chairman Christopher Phelan has warned that a Federal Reserve interest rate hike would be a mistake. Speaking amid falling inflation data, Phelan urged caution regarding monetary policy adjustments, as reports emerged highlighting concerns over the timing of potential rate increases.
content_ta: White House-ன் CEA Chairman Christopher Phelan, Federal Reserve வட்டி விகித உயர்வை இந்த வாரம் அறிவிப்பது தவறு என்று எச்சரித்துள்ளார். வீழ்ச்சியடைந்து வரும் பணவீக்க தரவுகளை சுட்டிக்காட்டி அவர் இந்த கருத்தை தெரிவித்தார்.

title: Mark Zuckerberg Joins the AI Doomsday Talk. What is He Saying?
summary:
Zuckerberg pushed back on AI doomsday warnings, saying market pressure already keeps AI labs safe and aligned.
The post Mark Zuckerberg Joins the AI Doomsday Talk. What is He Saying? appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Mark Zuckerberg recently addressed artificial intelligence doomsday predictions, offering a different perspective on the technology's future risks. He argued that existing market pressures are already sufficient to keep AI laboratories operating safely and responsibly, ensuring alignment without the need for extreme alarmist warnings.
content_ta: Mark Zuckerberg சமீபத்தில் செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு குறித்த பேரழிவுக் கணிப்புகள் பற்றிப் பேசினார். தொழில்நுட்பத்தின் எதிர்கால அபாயங்கள் குறித்து அவர் தனது மாறுபட்ட பார்வையைப் பகிர்ந்து கொண்டார். AI ஆய்வகங்கள் பாதுகாப்பாகவும் பொறுப்புடனும் செயல்பட தற்போதைய சந்தை அழுத்தங்களே போதுமானவை என்றும், தீவிரமான எச்சரிக்கைகள் தேவையில்லை என்றும் அவர் வாதிட்டார்.

title: Only 3 Altcoins Pass the Relative Strength Test, For Now
summary:
Kyle Doops screens altcoins by strength, not discounts. Only 3 of the top 20 sit within 36% of their records.
The post Only 3 Altcoins Pass the Relative Strength Test, For Now appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Kyle Doops has screened various altcoins based on relative strength rather than discounts, revealing that only three out of the top 20 altcoins are currently holding within 36% of their previous record highs. This analysis highlights the current market leaders showing resilience despite broader market trends.
content_ta: Kyle Doops அவர்கள் தள்ளுபடியை விட ஒப்பீட்டு வலிமையின் அடிப்படையில் altcoins-களை ஆய்வு செய்துள்ளார். இதில் top 20 altcoins-களில் மூன்று மட்டுமே தங்களின் முந்தைய சாதனையில் இருந்து 36%க்குள் நிலைத்து நிற்பதாகத் தெரியவந்துள்ளது.

title: Erebor Bank’s Free Stablecoin Plan Failed After Traders Found the Loophole
summary:
Erebor Bank tried to attract crypto firms by letting clients turn USDC and USDT into dollars at face value for free. Within months, professional trading firms including Wintermute and Galaxy Digital reportedly found a way to profit from the offer, leaving the bank to absorb the cost. Erebor quickly became one of Silicon Valley’s most
The post Erebor Bank’s Free Stablecoin Plan Failed After Traders Found the Loophole appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Erebor Bank attempted to attract crypto firms by offering free conversions of USDC and USDT into dollars at face value. However, professional trading firms such as Wintermute and Galaxy Digital exploited a loophole to profit from the offer, forcing the bank to absorb the heavy costs and causing the plan to fail.
content_ta: USDC மற்றும் USDT-ஐ எந்தவித கட்டணமும் இன்றி டாலர்களாக மாற்றும் இலவச திட்டத்தை Erebor Bank அறிமுகப்படுத்தியது. Wintermute மற்றும் Galaxy Digital போன்ற முன்னணி வர்த்தக நிறுவனங்கள் இதில் இருந்த ஓட்டையைப் பயன்படுத்தி லாபம் ஈட்டியதால், வங்கிக்கு கடும் இழப்பு ஏற்பட்டு இந்தத் திட்டம் தோல்வியடைந்தது.

title: Aave proposes Aave V4 loans against Bitcoin held with Anchorage
summary:
Aave's proposal could significantly enhance institutional participation in DeFi by offering secure, regulated collateral management, potentially increasing market stability.
The post Aave proposes Aave V4 loans against Bitcoin held with Anchorage appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Aave has proposed introducing Aave V4 loans backed by Bitcoin held with Anchorage. This initiative aims to boost institutional participation in the decentralized finance ecosystem by providing secure and regulated collateral management, which could lead to greater overall market stability.
content_ta: Anchorage நிறுவனத்தில் வைக்கப்பட்டுள்ள Bitcoin-ஐப் பயன்படுத்தி Aave V4 கடன்களை வழங்க Aave ஒரு புதிய திட்டத்தை முன்மொழிந்துள்ளது. பாதுகாப்பான மற்றும் ஒழுங்குபடுத்தப்பட்ட பிணைய மேலாண்மை மூலம் DeFi சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பில் நிறுவனங்களின் பங்களிப்பை அதிகரிப்பதை இந்த நடவடிக்கை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது.

title: Hundreds of tons of gold moved from NY Fed to Bank of England amid China buying spree
summary:
The gold transfer may signal shifting economic power dynamics, influencing global market stability and central bank strategies.
The post Hundreds of tons of gold moved from NY Fed to Bank of England amid China buying spree appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Hundreds of tons of gold have been transferred from the New York Fed to the Bank of England amid a notable buying spree by China. This major movement of precious metals could indicate shifting economic power dynamics globally, potentially impacting international market stability and future central bank strategies.

content: A recent study by Deloitte reveals that UK workers are spending nearly one billion pounds out of their own pockets on AI tools for work. This trend points to untapped market potential for AI providers while simultaneously raising significant security risks for employers who lack oversight into these unauthorized software applications.
content_ta: Deloitte நடத்திய ஆய்வின்படி, UK தொழிலாளர்கள் வேலைக்காக AI கருவிகளுக்குத் தங்கள் சொந்தப் பணத்திலிருந்து கிட்டத்தட்ட ஒரு பில்லியன் பவுண்டுகளைச் செலவிடுவதாகத் தெரியவந்துள்ளது. இந்தப் போக்கு AI நிறுவனங்களுக்கு புதிய சந்தை வாய்ப்புகளைக் காட்டுவதுடன், அனுமதியற்ற மென்பொருட்களைப் பயன்படுத்துவதால் ஏற்படும் பாதுகாப்பு அபாயங்களையும் முதலாளிகளுக்கு வெளிப்படுத்துகிறது.

title: Nubank and Sygnum Partner to Enable Nu Global’s Digital Asset Account
summary: Latin America’s digital bank Nubank (NYSE:NU) has taken another step beyond its home markets. Nu, which already serves more than 140 million customers in Brazil, Mexico and Colombia, has entered a strategic alliance with Swiss digital asset bank Sygnum to support the launch of Nu... Read More
content: Latin American digital bank Nubank has entered into a strategic alliance with Swiss digital asset bank Sygnum. The partnership aims to support the launch and development of Nu Global's digital asset account, expanding Nubank's services beyond its major home markets in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia to offer broader digital asset capabilities to its massive customer base.
content_ta: லத்தீன் அமெரிக்காவின் டிஜிட்டல் வங்கியான Nubank, சுவிட்சர்லாந்தைச் சேர்ந்த டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து வங்கியான Sygnum உடன் ஒரு மூலோபாய கூட்டணியை ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது. Nu Global-ன் டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து கணக்கின் தொடக்கத்தை ஆதரிப்பதை இந்த கூட்டு நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது. பிரேசில், மெக்சிகோ மற்றும் கொலம்பியா போன்ற முக்கிய சந்தைகளுக்கு அப்பால் தனது சேவைகளை விரிவுபடுத்தவும், வாடிக்கையாளர்களுக்கு புதிய டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து வசதிகளை வழங்கவும் இந்த partnership உதவுகிறது.

title: Crypto longs worth $570 million wiped out as Clarity Act fails
summary: Bullish crypto futures bets worth millions have been liquidated in 24 hours. Bitcoin and ether longs have taken in the most losses.
content: Bullish crypto futures bets worth over half a billion dollars were liquidated within a 24-hour period. The massive sell-off occurred after the Clarity Act failed. Bitcoin and ether long positions suffered the heaviest losses during this sudden market downturn, affecting traders across the broader digital asset market.
content_ta: 24 மணி நேரத்திற்குள் 570 மில்லியன் டக்கும் அதிகமான மதிப்புள்ள புல்லிஷ் கிரிப்டோ ஃபியூச்சர்ஸ் பந்தயங்கள் liquidate செய்யப்பட்டன. Clarity Act தோல்வியடைந்ததை அடுத்து இந்த பெரும் சரிவு ஏற்பட்டது. இந்த திடீர் சந்தை சரிவின் போது Bitcoin மற்றும் ether long நிலைகள் அதிகபட்ச இழப்புகளைச் சந்தித்தன.

title: XRP sinks 10% as the Clarity Act fails and bitcoin slides toward $76,000
summary: The Senate's 49-50 procedural vote left the crypto market structure bill 11 short of what it needed, and every major token fell.
content: XRP plunged by 10% following the failure of the Clarity Act in the United States Senate. The procedural vote fell short with a 49-50 result, leaving the crypto market structure bill without the necessary support. The legislative setback triggered a broader market downturn, with major tokens sliding as bitcoin dropped toward $76,000.
content_ta: United States Senate-ல் Clarity Act தோல்வியடைந்ததைத் தொடர்ந்து XRP விலையானது 10% வரை சரிந்தது. நடைமுறை வாக்கெடுப்பு 49-50 என்ற கணக்கில் தோல்வியடைந்ததால், கிரிப்டோ சந்தை கட்டமைப்பு மசோதா தேவையான ஆதரவைப் பெறவில்லை. இந்த சட்டப் பின்னடைவு காரணமாக பரந்த சந்தையில் சரிவு ஏற்பட்டதுடன், Bitcoin விலையும் $76,000-ஐ நோக்கி சரிந்தது.

title: US charges ex-Robinhood engineers over alleged pre-listing crypto trades
summary: The former employees allegedly earned more than $50,000 each by trading Hyperliquid perpetuals ahead of Robinhood token listings.
content: United States authorities have charged former Robinhood engineers with alleged illegal pre-listing cryptocurrency trades. According to investigators, the former employees used inside information regarding upcoming token listings on Robinhood to trade Hyperliquid perpetuals, reportedly making more than $50,000 each in illicit profits before the official public announcements were made.
content_ta: முன்னாள் Robinhood இன்ஜினியர்கள் மீது அமெரிக்க அதிகாரிகள் முறையற்ற முன்கூட்டிய கிரிப்டோ வர்த்தக குற்றச்சாட்டுகளைப் பதிவு செய்துள்ளனர். Robinhood-ல் வரவிருக்கும் டோக்கன் பட்டியல்கள் பற்றிய உள்விவரங்களைப் பயன்படுத்தி முன்னாள் ஊழியர்கள் Hyperliquid பெர்பெச்சுவல்ஸ் வர்த்தகம் செய்ததாகவும், உத்தியோகப்பூர்வ அறிவிப்புகளுக்கு முன்பாக தலா $50,000-க்கும் அதிகமான லாபம் ஈட்டியதாகவும் புலனாய்வாளர்கள் தெரிவிக்கின்றனர்.

title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $450M in biggest outflow since June
summary: The $450 million withdrawal came as Bitcoin fell 2.5% and the CLARITY Act failed to advance in the Senate, with Fidelity and BlackRock funds leading the outflows.
content: Bitcoin exchange-traded funds recorded $450 million in outflows, marking the largest withdrawal since June. The downturn coincided with a 2.5% drop in Bitcoin's price and the failure of the CLARITY Act to advance in the Senate. Major funds managed by Fidelity and BlackRock led the heavy capital withdrawals during this period of market decline.
content_ta: Bitcoin ETF-களில் இருந்து $450 மில்லியன் வெளியேறியுள்ளது. கடந்த ஜூன் மாதத்திற்குப் பிறகு பதிவான மிகப்பெரிய வெளியேற்றம் இதுவாகும். Bitcoin விலை 2.5% சரிந்ததும், CLARITY Act செனட் சபையில் நிறைவேறத் தவறியதும் இதற்கு முக்கியக் காரணங்களாகும். இந்தச் சரிவின் போது Fidelity மற்றும் BlackRock நிறுவனங்களின் நிதிகள் அதிக அளவில் முதலீடுகளை வெளியேற்றின.

title: Solana nearly froze as a single routing error took 29% of the network stake offline
summary:
The newly detailed Teraswitch failure stayed below Solana’s finality-halt threshold, while independent telemetry showed delayed finality and sharply lower throughput.
The post Solana nearly froze as a single routing error took 29% of the network stake offline appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: Solana recently experienced a major disruption when a routing error, known as the Teraswitch failure, took 29 percent of the network stake offline. Although the issue caused delayed finality and significantly lower throughput, the network managed to stay just below its finality-halt threshold, preventing a total freeze. Independent telemetry confirmed the performance impact on the blockchain.
content_ta: Solana நெட்வொர்க்கில் ஏற்பட்ட ஒரு ரூட்டிங் பிழை காரணமாக 29 சதவீத ஸ்டேக் ஆஃப்லைன் ஆனது. Teraswitch கோளாறு என அழைக்கப்படும் இந்த பிரச்சனையால் நெட்வொர்க்கின் வேகம் குறைந்து, பரிவர்த்தனைகள் தாமதமாகின. இருப்பினும், நெட்வொர்க் முற்றிலுமாக முடங்கும் அளவிற்கு செல்லாமல் தப்பியது.

title: This Crypto Sector Is Up 213% Since Bitcoin’s 2025 Peak – One Coin Is Driving It
summary: Much of that sector-wide gain comes down to one token, Zcash, which now represents about 62% of the privacy market.
content: A specific cryptocurrency sector has surged significantly since Bitcoin's 2025 peak, posting a 213% gain. Market data indicates that this massive growth is primarily driven by one token, Zcash. The privacy-focused asset now accounts for approximately 62% of the entire privacy coin market, propelling the wider sector upward amid ongoing investor interest in specialized digital currencies.
content_ta: Bitcoin-ன் 2025 உச்சத்திற்குப் பிறகு ஒரு குறிப்பிட்ட கிரிப்டோகரன்சி துறை 213% அளவுக்கு குறிப்பிடத்தக்க வளர்ச்சியைப் பெற்றுள்ளது. இந்த லாபத்திற்கு Zcash என்ற ஒரு டோக்கனே முக்கியக் காரணமாக உள்ளது. தற்போது தனியுரிமை நாணயச் சந்தையில் சுமார் 62% பங்கைக் கொண்டுள்ள இந்த சொத்து, ஒட்டுமொத்த துறையையும் முன்னெடுத்துச் செல்கிறது.

title: Bulgaria tightens crypto tax rules, targets self-custody withdrawals
summary: EU is gearing for a strict crypto regulatory framework on AML and mandatory tax reporting from 2027.
content: Bulgaria is tightening its cryptocurrency tax regulations, with a specific focus on self-custody withdrawals. This move aligns with broader European Union efforts to implement a strict regulatory framework covering anti-money laundering and mandatory tax reporting, which is scheduled to take effect starting in 2027.
content_ta: Bulgaria நாட்டில் cryptocurrency வரி விதிமுறைகள் கடுமையாக்கப்பட்டு வருகின்றன, குறிப்பாக self-custody withdrawals மீது கூடுதல் கவனம் செலுத்தப்படுகிறது. இந்த நடவடிக்கை, anti-money laundering மற்றும் கட்டாய வரி அறிக்கையிடல் தொடர்பான கடுமையான ஒழுங்குமுறை சட்டங்களை 2027 முதல் அமல்படுத்தத் தயாராகி வரும் European Union-ன் முயற்சிகளுடன் ஒத்துப்போகிறது.

title: Raoul Pal Says Bitcoin Beats Gold as the Real Debasement Hedge
summary:
Raoul Pal says Bitcoin, not gold, is the real debasement hedge as its adoption curve drives price gains.
The post Raoul Pal Says Bitcoin Beats Gold as the Real Debasement Hedge appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Macro expert Raoul Pal stated that Bitcoin is a better hedge against currency debasement than gold. According to Pal, the adoption curve of Bitcoin is the primary driver behind its ongoing price gains, positioning the cryptocurrency as the superior option for investors looking to protect their wealth.
content_ta: கரன்சி மதிப்பிழப்புக்கு எதிராக தங்கத்தை விட Bitcoin சிறந்த பாதுகாப்பு என்று மேக்ரோ நிபுணர் Raoul Pal தெரிவித்துள்ளார். Pal-இன் கூற்றுப்படி, Bitcoin-ன் ஏற்பு வளைவே அதன் தொடர்ச்சியான விலை உயர்வுக்கு முக்கியக் காரணமாகும், இது முதலீட்டாளர்களுக்கு சிறந்த தேர்வாக அமைகிறது.

title: Marathon Digital Holdings buys 1,292 Bitcoin for $98.6M
summary:
MARA's Bitcoin acquisition signals a strategic pivot, potentially influencing other miners to reassess reserve strategies amid evolving market dynamics.
The post Marathon Digital Holdings buys 1,292 Bitcoin for $98.6M appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Marathon Digital Holdings has purchased 1,292 Bitcoin for approximately $98.6 million. This significant acquisition highlights the company's ongoing strategy regarding its digital asset reserves. Market observers note that such moves by major mining firms can influence broader industry trends and reserve management practices as market conditions continue to evolve over time.
content_ta: Marathon Digital Holdings நிறுவனம் தோராயமாக $98.6 மில்லியன் மதிப்பில் 1,292 Bitcoin-களை வாங்கியுள்ளது. இந்த மிகப்பெரிய முதலீடு, நிறுவனத்தின் டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து இருப்பு குறித்த தற்போதைய உத்தியைக் காட்டுகிறது. சந்தை நிலவரங்கள் தொடர்ந்து மாறிவரும் நிலையில், முக்கிய மைனிங் நிறுவனங்களின் இத்தகைய நடவடிக்கைகள் ஒட்டுமொத்த துறை சார்ந்த போக்குகளையும் இருப்பு மேலாண்மை முறைகளையும் பாதிக்கலாம் என்று சந்தை ஆய்வாளர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர்.

title: 7 Republicans join Dems to limit Trump’s Iran war powers
summary:
The bipartisan move signals increased legislative oversight on military actions, potentially leading to a more cautious U.S. foreign policy approach.
The post 7 Republicans join Dems to limit Trump’s Iran war powers appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: A bipartisan group of lawmakers, including seven Republicans, joined Democrats to pass a measure limiting Trump’s Iran war powers. This legislative move signals increased oversight on military actions and points toward a potentially more cautious United States foreign policy approach regarding conflicts in the region.
content_ta: ஏழு Republicans உட்பட இரு கட்சிகளைச் சேர்ந்த சட்டமியற்றுபவர்கள் இணைந்து Trump-ன் Iran போர் அதிகாரங்களை வரம்பிற்குட்படுத்தும் தீர்மானத்தை நிறைவேற்றினர். இந்த நடவடிக்கை இராணுவ நடவடிக்கைகளின் மீது நாடாளுமன்றத்தின் கண்காணிப்பு அதிகரித்துள்ளதைக் காட்டுகிறது.

title: California wealth tax measure Proposition 40 holds narrow lead in poll
summary:
The narrow lead for Proposition 40 highlights the contentious nature of wealth taxation, potentially influencing future fiscal policies and political alignments.
The post California wealth tax measure Proposition 40 holds narrow lead in poll appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: A recent poll shows Proposition 40, a California wealth tax measure, currently holds a narrow lead. The initiative has sparked significant debate regarding fiscal policy, highlighting deep divisions among voters. If passed, the measure could set a precedent for future taxation strategies across the state. Stakeholders continue to monitor the polling closely as political campaigns intensify leading up to the final vote.
content_ta: California-ன் சொத்து வரி மசோதாவான Proposition 40, சமீபத்திய கருத்துக்கணிப்பில் மிகக் குறைந்த வாக்கு வித்தியாசத்தில் முன்னிலையில் உள்ளது. இந்த மசோதா நிதி கொள்கைகள் தொடர்பாக வாக்காளர்களிடையே கடும் விவாதங்களை ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இது நிறைவேற்றப்பட்டால், எதிர்கால வரி விதிப்பு முறைகளுக்கு ஒரு முன்மாதிரியாக அமையும். இறுதி வாக்குப்பதிவிற்கு முன்னதாக அரசியல் பிரச்சாரங்கள் தீவிரமடைந்து வரும் நிலையில், இந்த கருத்துக்கணிப்பு முடிவுகளை பலரும் உன்னிப்பாக கவனித்து வருகின்றனர்.

title: South Korean retail traders report $250M fraud losses in H1 2026
summary:
The surge in fraud losses highlights the urgent need for stronger regulatory measures and investor education to protect retail traders.
The post South Korean retail traders report $250M fraud losses in H1 2026 appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Retail traders in South Korea have reported significant financial losses totaling $250 million due to fraudulent activities during the first half of 2026. This trend has prompted concerns regarding market security and the vulnerability of individual investors. Industry observers emphasize that these developments highlight an urgent requirement for enhanced regulatory oversight and improved investor education initiatives to better protect market participants from ongoing deceptive schemes in the region.
content_ta: 2026-ஆம் ஆண்டின் முதல் பாதியில் South Korea-வில் உள்ள சில்லறை முதலீட்டாளர்கள் சுமார் $250 மில்லியன் மதிப்பிலான மோசடியால் பணத்தை இழந்துள்ளதாகத் தெரிவித்துள்ளனர். இந்தச் சம்பவம் சந்தைப் பாதுகாப்பு மற்றும் முதலீட்டாளர்களின் பாதுகாப்பு குறித்த கவலையை ஏற்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இத்தகைய மோசடிகளில் இருந்து முதலீட்டாளர்களைப் பாதுகாக்க, கடுமையான ஒழுங்குமுறை நடவடிக்கைகள் மற்றும் விழிப்புணர்வு முயற்சிகள் அவசியம் என்று சந்தை நிபுணர்கள் வலியுறுத்துகின்றனர்.

title: Saudi Arabia accuses Houthis of targeting Mecca, warns of ‘red line’
summary:
Heightened tensions risk disrupting global oil supply chains, impacting international shipping routes and regional stability.
The post Saudi Arabia accuses Houthis of targeting Mecca, warns of ‘red line’ appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Saudi Arabia has formally accused Houthi rebels of attempting to target Mecca, issuing a stern warning that such actions represent a crossing of a critical red line. This escalation has intensified regional tensions, raising widespread concerns regarding the stability of international shipping routes and the potential for significant disruptions to global oil supply chains as the conflict continues to evolve.
content_ta: Saudi Arabia, Houthi போராளிகள் Mecca-வை குறிவைக்க முயற்சிப்பதாக குற்றம் சாட்டியுள்ளது. இத்தகைய செயல்கள் ஒரு முக்கிய எல்லையை மீறுவதாக எச்சரித்துள்ளது. இந்த மோதல் பிராந்தியத்தில் பதற்றத்தை அதிகரித்துள்ளதுடன், சர்வதேச கடல்வழிப் பாதைகளின் பாதுகாப்பு மற்றும் உலகளாவிய கச்சா எண்ணெய் விநியோகச் சங்கிலியில் ஏற்படக்கூடிய பாதிப்புகள் குறித்து பெரும் கவலையை உருவாக்கியுள்ளது.

title: AI assistant startup Instinct targets $10B valuation in new funding talks: Report
summary:
Instinct's ambitious valuation pursuit highlights the growing demand and competitive landscape for AI-driven personal assistant technologies.
The post AI assistant startup Instinct targets $10B valuation in new funding talks: Report appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: AI assistant startup Instinct is reportedly in talks for a new funding round that could value the company at $10 billion. This ambitious valuation highlights the surging investor demand and competitive landscape surrounding AI-driven personal assistant technologies in the tech market today.
content_ta: AI அசிஸ்டண்ட் startup-ஆன Instinct, புதிய நிதி திரட்டல் பேச்சுவார்த்தைகள் மூலம் $10 பில்லியன் மதிப்பீட்டை எட்ட இலக்கு நிர்ணயித்துள்ளதாகத் தகவல்கள் வெளியாகியுள்ளன. இந்த மதிப்பீட்டு முயற்சி, AI அடிப்படையிலான பர்சனல் அசிஸ்டண்ட் தொழில்நுட்பங்களுக்கு சந்தையில் அதிகரித்து வரும் தேவையைக் காட்டுகிறது.

title: House opposes Iran conflict escalation ahead of midterms
summary:
The House's stance may shift U.S. foreign policy dynamics, affecting market perceptions and influencing future diplomatic negotiations.
The post House opposes Iran conflict escalation ahead of midterms appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: The House of Representatives has taken a stance opposing the escalation of conflict with Iran ahead of the upcoming midterms. This political development could potentially shift United States foreign policy dynamics, impact market perceptions, and influence future diplomatic negotiations going forward.
content_ta: வரவிருக்கும் midterms தேர்தலுக்கு முன்னதாக, Iran உடன் மோதலை அதிகரிப்பதை House எதிர்க்கிறது. இந்த அரசியல் மாற்றம் United States இன் வெளியுறவுக் கொள்கை இயக்கவியலை மாற்றியமைக்கவும், சந்தை கணிப்புகளைப் பாதிக்கவும், எதிர்கால இராஜதந்திர பேச்சுவார்த்தைகளை സ്വാധீനിക്കவும் கூடும்.

title: China calls for global AI oversight amid US tech rivalry
summary:
China's AI oversight call highlights strategic security concerns, potentially affecting U.S.-China tech relations and market dynamics.
The post China calls for global AI oversight amid US tech rivalry appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: China has urged for global oversight of artificial intelligence amid growing technological rivalry with the United States. This call emphasizes strategic security concerns that could impact bilateral tech relations and broader market dynamics as nations compete for dominance in advanced technology sectors.
content_ta: US-உடன் அதிகரித்து வரும் தொழில்நுட்ப போட்டியின் மத்தியில், ஆர்டிஃபிஷியல் இன்டெலிஜென்ஸ் (AI) துறைக்கு உலகளாவிய கண்காணிப்பு தேவை என்று சீனா வலியுறுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த அறைகூவல் மூலோபாய பாதுகாப்பு கவலைகளை முன்னிலைப்படுத்துகிறது, இது இரு நாடுகளின் தொழில்நுட்ப உறவுகள் மற்றும் சந்தை இயக்கவியலை பாதிக்கக்கூடும்.

title: Fed meeting is shaping up to be a nightmare for Warsh. Bitcoin might still shine
summary: An aggressive market expectations trap and a strict aversion to forward guidance have backed the Fed chair into a corner, where failing to deliver a hawkish message risks destroying the central bank’s inflation-fighting credibility.
content: The upcoming Federal Reserve meeting presents a major challenge for leadership. Strict limits on forward guidance and aggressive market expectations have created a difficult situation for the central bank. Failing to deliver a strong message on inflation risks damaging its credibility, while Bitcoin may continue to perform well despite these macroeconomic pressures.
content_ta: வரவிருக்கும் Federal Reserve கூட்டம் தலைமைக்கு ஒரு பெரிய சவாலை அளிக்கிறது. கடுமையான வழிகாட்டுதல்களும் ஆக்ரோஷமான சந்தை எதிர்பார்ப்புகளும் மத்திய வங்கிக்கு ஒரு கடினமான சூழ்நிலையை உருவாக்கியுள்ளன. பணவீக்கம் குறித்த வலுவான செய்தியை வழங்கத் தவறினால் அதன் நம்பகத்தன்மைக்கு தீங்கு விளைவிக்கும் அபாயம் உள்ளது, அதே நேரத்தில் இந்த மேக்ரோ பொருளாதார அழுத்தங்கள் இருந்தபோதிலும் Bitcoin தொடர்ந்து சிறப்பாக செயல்படலாம்.

title: AI has been a ‘net negative’ for crypto: Phemex CEO
summary: Federico Variola says AI has diverted capital from crypto and is empowering attackers, while rising cybersecurity costs could push the industry toward greater centralization.
content: Phemex CEO Federico Variola stated that artificial intelligence has been a net negative for the cryptocurrency industry. According to Variola, AI has diverted investment capital away from crypto and empowered cyber attackers. Additionally, the resulting rise in cybersecurity costs could potentially drive the cryptocurrency sector toward greater centralization in the future.
content_ta: Phemex-யின் CEO Federico Variola, செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு (AI) தொழில்நுட்பம் கிரிப்டோகரன்சி துறைக்கு ஒரு பின்னடைவாக மாறியுள்ளதாக தெரிவித்துள்ளார். Variola-வின் கூற்றுப்படி, AI ஆனது முதலீட்டு மூலதனத்தை கிரிப்டோவிலிருந்து திசைதிருப்புவதோடு, சைபர் தாக்குதல் நடத்துபவர்களுக்கும் உதவுகிறது. மேலும், அதிகரித்து வரும் சைபர் பாதுகாப்பு செலவுகள் எதிர்காலத்தில் இந்தத் துறையை அதிக மையப்படுத்தப்பட்ட (centralization) முறைக்கு தள்ளக்கூடும்.

title: Underdog sues Connecticut to stop sports prediction market crackdown
summary: The lawsuit follows cease-and-desist orders the state issued to prediction market platforms, including Underdog, Polymarket, and Coinbase.
content: Underdog has filed a lawsuit against Connecticut to halt the state's crackdown on sports prediction markets. This legal action comes after regulatory authorities issued cease-and-desist orders to several prediction market platforms operating in the region, including Underdog, Polymarket, and Coinbase, aiming to stop their current operations.
content_ta: Sports prediction market-களுக்கு எதிரான நடவடிக்கையைத் தடுப்பதற்காக Connecticut அரசுக்கு எதிராக Underdog நிறுவனம் வழக்கு தொடந்துள்ளது. Underdog, Polymarket மற்றும் Coinbase உள்ளிட்ட பல்வேறு prediction market தளங்களுக்கு மாநில ஒழுங்குமுறை அதிகாரிகள் cease-and-desist உத்தரவுகளைப் பிறப்பித்ததைத் தொடர்ந்து இந்த சட்ட நடவடிக்கை எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: Brazil’s B3 gets DIGY11, a new ETF tracking Bitcoin treasury preferred stock
summary:

content: Brazil’s B3 stock exchange has welcomed DIGY11, a new exchange-traded fund designed to track Bitcoin treasury preferred stock. The real-hedged Brazilian fund bundles Strategy and Strive preferred shares together. However, the fund leaves distribution payouts and unit returns entirely unguaranteed for investors.
content_ta: பிரேசிலின் B3 பங்குச் சந்தை, Bitcoin கருவூல முன்னுரிமைப் பங்குகளைக் கண்காணிக்கும் DIGY11 என்ற புதிய ETF நிதியை அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்த பிரேசில் நிதி Strategy மற்றும் Strive முன்னுரிமைப் பங்குகளை ஒருங்கிணைக்கிறது. இருப்பினும், இந்த நிதியானது முதலீட்டாளர்களுக்கு வருமானம் மற்றும் பங்கீடுகளை எந்தவித உத்தரவாதமும் இல்லாமல் வழங்குகிறது.

title: BASIS.pro Expands On-Chain Infrastructure with XDC Network Partnership and Zypher DAO as Auto Earn Goes Live
summary: [PRESS RELEASE – London, United Kingdom, September 16th, 2026] New developments extend BASIS across real-world asset and AI-native infrastructure while introducing automated reward restaking for BTC, ETH, SOL, and PAXG participants BASIS, the institutional-grade crypto yield and staking platform built on market-neutral execution infrastructure, is continuing to expand its institutional footprint with three new developments: […]
content: BASIS.pro has announced major developments, expanding its on-chain infrastructure through a partnership with XDC Network and Zypher DAO. The institutional-grade crypto yield platform also launched its Auto Earn feature, introducing automated reward restaking for assets including BTC, ETH, SOL, and PAXG. These updates aim to extend the platform across real-world asset and AI-native infrastructure, strengthening its institutional footprint.
content_ta: BASIS.pro நிறுவனம் XDC Network மற்றும் Zypher DAO உடனான கூட்டுறவு மூலம் தனது on-chain infrastructure-ஐ விரிவுபடுத்துவதாக அறிவித்துள்ளது. மேலும், BTC, ETH, SOL மற்றும் PAXG போன்ற சொத்துகளுக்கு தானியங்கி வெகுமதி மறு-பங்கு வழங்கும் Auto Earn அம்சத்தையும் இந்நிறுவனம் அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது.

title: Ripple CEO Breaks Silence After CLARITY Act Vote Fails: XRP’s Legal Footing Unchanged
summary: Garlinghouse expects the SEC and the CFTC to pick up more of the regulatory work while Congress remains stuck on legislation.
content: Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse has spoken out following the failure of the CLARITY Act vote. He stated that the legal footing for XRP remains completely unchanged. Garlinghouse anticipates that regulatory agencies like the SEC and the CFTC will likely increase their oversight role while the US Congress remains deadlocked on passing new cryptocurrency legislation.
content_ta: CLARITY Act மசோதாவின் வாக்குப்பதிவு தோல்வியடைந்ததைத் தொடர்ந்து Ripple நிறுவனத்தின் CEO Brad Garlinghouse தனது கருத்துக்களைத் தெரிவித்துள்ளார். XRP-ன் சட்டப்பூர்வ நிலை மாறாமல் உள்ளதாக அவர் கூறினார். அமெரிக்க நாடாளுமன்றத்தில் சட்டம் இயற்றுவதில் தாமதம் ஏற்பட்டுள்ளதால், SEC மற்றும் CFTC போன்ற ஒழுங்குமுறை அமைப்புகள் தங்கள் மேற்பார்வை பணிகளை அதிகரிக்கக்கூடும் என்று அவர் எதிர்பார்க்கிறார்.

title: Bitcoin, Ethereum ETFs Bleed $592 Million as Clarity Act Fails in Senate
summary:
Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH) spot ETFs shed a combined $592 million on September 15. Both products posted their deepest single-day outflows in months. The outflows landed as the CLARITY Act failed to advance in the US Senate. The setback pulled prices lower, and capital followed them out. Ethereum ETFs Record Their Worst Session Since
The post Bitcoin, Ethereum ETFs Bleed $592 Million as Clarity Act Fails in Senate appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Spot Bitcoin and Ethereum exchange-traded funds recorded massive outflows totaling $592 million following the failure of the CLARITY Act to advance in the United States Senate. The significant setback triggered a sharp drop in cryptocurrency prices and resulted in the largest single-day capital withdrawal for these investment products in several months.
content_ta: United States Senate-ல் CLARITY Act தோல்வியடைந்ததைத் தொடர்ந்து, spot Bitcoin மற்றும் Ethereum exchange-traded funds ஆகியவற்றிலிருந்து மொத்தம் $592 மில்லியன் வெளியேறியுள்ளது. இந்த பெரிய பின்னடைவு cryptocurrency விலைகளில் கடுமையான வீழ்ச்சியை ஏற்படுத்தியதுடன், பல மாதங்களில் இந்த முதலீட்டுப் பொருட்களிலிருந்து ஒரே நாளில் வெளியேறிய மிகப்பெரிய மூலதனமாகவும் பதிவாகியுள்ளது.

title: Iran conflict adds €90B to EU fossil fuel import costs, says von der Leyen
summary:
The EU's increased fossil fuel costs highlight the vulnerability of energy security to geopolitical tensions, urging a shift to renewables.
The post Iran conflict adds €90B to EU fossil fuel import costs, says von der Leyen appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: According to Ursula von der Leyen, the Iran conflict has added €90 billion to the European Union's fossil fuel import costs. This significant increase underscores the severe vulnerability of the EU's energy security to ongoing geopolitical tensions, further emphasizing the urgent need to accelerate the transition toward renewable energy sources.
content_ta: Ursula von der Leyen அவர்களின் கூற்றுப்படி, Iran மோதலால் European Union-ன் புதைபடிவ எரிபொருள் இறக்குமதி செலவு €90 பில்லியன் அதிகரித்துள்ளது. இந்த குறிப்பிடத்தக்க உயர்வு, புவிசார் அரசியல் மோதல்களால் EU-வின் எரிபொருள் பாதுகாப்பு எவ்வளவு பாதிக்கப்படக்கூடியது என்பதை அடிக்கோடிட்டுக் காட்டுகிறது மற்றும் புதுப்பிக்கத்தக்க எரிபொருளுக்கு மாறுவதை விரைவுபடுத்துவதன் அவசியத்தை வலியுறுத்துகிறது.

title: European militaries boost missile arsenals amid Ukraine conflict
summary:
European military enhancements may deter Russian aggression, influencing regional stability and altering future geopolitical dynamics.
The post European militaries boost missile arsenals amid Ukraine conflict appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: European militaries are actively strengthening their missile arsenals in response to the ongoing Ukraine conflict. These military enhancements are seen as a potential deterrent against Russian aggression, which could significantly influence regional stability and alter future geopolitical dynamics across Europe as nations adapt to new security challenges.
content_ta: உkraine மோதலின் பின்னணியில் ஐரோப்பிய ராணுவங்கள் தங்களின் ஏவுகணை இருப்பை தீவிரமாக அதிகரித்து வருகின்றன. இந்த ராணுவ பலப்படுத்தல் ரஷ்யாவின் ஆக்கிரமிப்பைத் தடுக்கக்கூடிய ஒரு சாத்தியமான நடவடிக்கையாகக் கருதப்படுவதோடு, பிராந்திய ஸ்திரத்தன்மையைப் பாதிக்கவும் எதிர்கால புவிசார் அரசியல் இயக்கவியலை மாற்றவும் கூடும்.

title: General strike in Kurdish cities marks Mahsa Amini death anniversary
summary:

title: Sumsub Launches Workforce Verification to Secure Enterprise Systems Against AI-Powered Fraud
summary:
Sumsub, the first AI-powered trust infrastructure for compliance operations at scale, today announced Workforce Verification, an integrated solution that embeds identity document verification, biometric liveness, and background screening directly into enterprise IAM and HR platforms. Built for multinational organizations, the offering provides continuous identity assurance across the full employee lifecycle—from recruitment to account recovery—to prevent unauthorized system access.
Standard Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms enforce access controls, but they only verify that a user holds valid credentials—such as a password or MFA token—not the actual identity of the individual presenting them. This gap leaves organizations vulnerable to credential theft, deepfakes, and social engineering. Recent high-profile security incidents and evolving threats have heightened the need for workforce identity verification. Gartner research cites help-desk account recovery as the primary driver of enterprise interest in workforce verification, while projecting that 30% of enterprises will distrust isolated face-biometric verification by 2026 due to advancing AI spoofing risks.
“IAM systems manage access, but a valid credential only proves possession, not identity,” said Andrew Novoselsky, Chief Product Officer at Sumsub. “In an enterprise setting, a compromised employee account costs the keys to critical business operations. Workforce Verification plugs seamlessly into existing IAM and HR platforms to trigger live, deepfake-resistant checks at high-risk moments, stopping fraud without replacing existing infrastructure.”
Sumsub’s Workforce Verification operates as an active policy layer over existing IT architecture. After initially verifying a new hire's government ID during the onboarding process to establish a secure baseline, the solution provides continuous ongoing protection. When an IAM system later flags a high-risk trigger for an active employee—such as a password reset, privilege escalation, or suspicious login—Sumsub executes an immediate step-up check combining biometric liveness and passive risk signals before access is granted. 
Key benefits include:
Reduction in Manual Work: Closes account-recovery loopholes by replacing vulnerable security questions with live biometric identity checks.
Proactive Risk Reduction: Prevents fraudulent candidates and contractors from gaining unauthorized access to internal systems, sensitive data, or intellectual property.
Continuous Lifecycle Protection: Dynamically re-verifies identity at high-risk operational moments rather than relying solely on a one-time onboarding check.
AI-Resistant Security: Defends against synthetic identity threats with up to 99.98% deepfake detection efficiency.
Backed by a fraud prevention network of over 1.5 billion enriched identities, the solution combines automated background screening with custom document verification to validate employment history and credentials.
NoYesFraud Detection16 Sep, 2026
content: Sumsub has launched Workforce Verification, a new solution designed to secure enterprise systems against AI-powered fraud. The offering integrates identity document verification, biometric liveness, and background screening into existing IAM and HR platforms. It provides continuous identity assurance throughout the employee lifecycle to prevent unauthorized access, defending organizations against deepfakes, credential theft, and social engineering threats during high-risk moments like account recovery.
content_ta: AI-மூலம் நடக்கும் மோசடிகளிலிருந்து நிறுவனங்களின் அமைப்புகளைப் பாதுகாக்க Sumsub நிறுவனம் Workforce Verification என்ற புதிய தீர்வை அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இந்தத் தீர்வு அடையாள ஆவண சரிபார்ப்பு, பயோமெட்ரிக் சோதனைகள் மற்றும் பின்னணி சரிபார்ப்பு ஆகியவற்றை IAM மற்றும் HR தளங்களுடன் ஒருங்கிணைக்கிறது. பணியாளர் சேர்க்கை முதல் கணக்கு மீட்பு வரை தொடர்ச்சியான அடையாளப் பாதுகாப்பை இது வழங்குகிறது.

title: Money20/20 Middle East Day Two Sees Landmark Saudi-Qatar Payments Agreement as Major Fintech Investment and Expansion Announcements Continue
summary:
The second day of Money20/20 Middle East in Riyadh brought a series of major agreements, investment announcements and industry developments, led by a landmark agreement between the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) and Qatar Central Bank enabling the cross-border use of national payment cards mada and HIMYAN.
H.E. Ayman M. Al Sayari, Governor, Saudi Central Bank (SAMA), delivered the opening keynote of day two, addressing the future of financial ecosystems and the importance of scaling with stability. During his remarks, H.E. Al Sayari highlighted the significant growth of Saudi Arabia’s fintech sector, which now includes 371 companies operating across the Kingdom. He also pointed to the continued expansion of digital financial services, with electronic payments accounting for more than 85% of retail payment transactions and more than 307 entities currently operating under the Kingdom’s open banking framework.
He also highlighted continued investor confidence in the Saudi market, with investment in the sector exceeding SAR 30 billion by the end of H1 2026, further strengthening the Kingdom’s position as an attractive regional investment destination.
That momentum was reflected in a series of announcements made on day two, led by the cross-border agreement between the Saudi Central Bank and Qatar Central Bank. The agreement will enable mada and HIMYAN cardholders to use their respective national payment cards seamlessly and securely across Saudi Arabia and Qatar.
Meanwhile, barq, the digital payments company, announced the close of a Series A funding round worth USD 329.5 million, at a valuation of USD 1.85 billion, cementing its position among the fastest-growing fintech companies in Saudi Arabia and wider region. Network International also announced the launch of its merchant acquiring services in Saudi Arabia, including point-of-sale (POS) and e-commerce payment solutions for merchants operating across physical and digital channels.
Beyond the announcements, discussions across the programme examined the conditions needed to attract global capital, the balance between technology and trust, the growing influence of AI on financial decision-making, and the role of regulation in building resilient financial systems.
Mohamed Alaadin, General Partner at Development Partners International, said: “Saudi Arabia has shifted from being an interesting market to being an investable market. For investors, that is a significant distinction: we can now underwrite opportunities based on clearer regulation, deeper pools of capital, follow-on funding and an increasingly credible path to liquidity and exits.”
Karim Samakie, General Manager – Fintech Sector at the Ministry of Investment, Saudi Arabia, added: “There is a vast range of opportunities for international investors in Saudi Arabia. In fintech and technology in particular, many companies have reached a level of maturity where they are regulated, established and serving meaningful market segments, creating opportunities not only for investment but also for acquisitions and international companies looking for a route into the Kingdom.”
The issue of the trust balance between technology and human touch was explored in “The Trust Layer: Building Financial Systems People Choose to Use.” Fahad Al Guthami, CEO of American Express Saudi Arabia, said: “The more the world becomes digital, the more the world will require trust. You can build the best accessibility, but if the trust and security are not there, it will not go far, it can actually create damage rather than opportunity.
The role of AI in financial decision-making was also examined during the session “Who Should Allocate Capital.”. Fariha Ansari Javed, Partner, GCC & Global Capital Formation at Stride Ventures, said: “There is a big difference between capability and accountability. AI can help us analyse data, identify what we may be missing, but it never takes away human judgement. Ultimately, accountability remains with the allocator, and AI should support rather than replace that judgement.”
Hussain Almarhoon, Founding and Managing Partner at HALA Capital, agreed, adding: “AI can automate processes, bring fragmented information together and provide stronger decision support, but it can also create a false sense of confidence when incomplete data is combined with sophisticated analysis. That is why we use AI as an intellectual challenger rather than a decision-maker.”
In another thought-provoking session titled “Governments as Financial Systems Builders,” which explored how governments are building the institutions and infrastructure that enable capital to thrive, Senator Osita Izunaso, Chairman, Senate Committee on Capital Market, Federal Republic of Nigeria, said: “Money cannot move in an atmosphere of uncertainty, and money cannot move when there is no confidence. Legislation is paramount because once the law is made, the regulator has the framework to regulate.”
Akshata Namjoshi, Equity Partner at KARM Legal, said: “What determines whether a regulator is ready is how much public consultation it has undertaken. Regulators need industry discussions, market assessment and feedback-based engagement to understand what companies, lawyers and service providers need and to build a framework that can work over the long term.” 
Together, the announcements and discussions across day two reflected a financial ecosystem moving increasingly from ambition into implementation, with new infrastructure, capital and services coming into the market alongside continued dialogue between regulators, financial institutions, fintech companies, investors and technology leaders.
Steve Durning, Associate Vice President at Tahaluf, said: "A lot of what the industry has been talking about for the past few years is now becoming real. AI is moving into everyday financial services, payments are evolving incredibly quickly, and we are seeing new products and business models come to market all the time. What has been interesting at Money20/20 Middle East is hearing those conversations move beyond what might be possible and into what companies are actually doing, what customers need and what it takes to scale. Having regulators, banks, fintechs, investors and technology companies here together makes those conversations much more useful."
Money20/20 Middle East continues at the Riyadh Exhibition & Convention Centre in Malham through 16 September, with further announcements, investment activity and industry discussions expected across the closing day.
Registration and further information are available at www.money2020middleeast.com.

title: MEXC Releases July–August Security Report: Over 38 Million USDT in Risk-Related Funds Intercepted, Futures Insurance Fund Reaches 792 Million USDT
summary: Mutsamudu, Comoros, September 16, 2026 – MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, has released its July–August 2026 security report. The report shows that MEXC successfully intercepted all 215 reports involving risk-related funds during the period, covering approximately 38.66 million USDT. The total balance of the Futures Insurance Fund rose to 792 million USDT. Meanwhile, the reserve ratios for BTC, ETH, USDT, and USDC all remained above 100%.   In July and August 2026, the crypto industry recorded 184 security incidents, with reported losses totaling approximately $535 million. Phishing and fraud incidents, together with endpoint and supply-chain security incidents, accounted for approximately 48% of the total. At the same time, a growing number of attackers are using AI to auto-generate phishing content and help write malware, increasing the efficiency of their attacks. As attack methods become more diverse, promptly identifying and intercepting risk-related funds and strengthening cross-platform investigation have become increasingly important to reducing user losses.   All 215 Reports of Risk-Related Funds Successfully Intercepted, Covering 38.66 Million USDT In July and August, MEXC assisted with 215 reports involving externally stolen or fraud-related funds flowing into the platform. All 215 cases were successfully intercepted, covering 38,655,490 USDT. Of these cases, 42 involved assistance with judicial freezes. Compared with the previous reporting period, the number of successfully intercepted cases increased by approximately 2,971%, while the value of intercepted funds increased by approximately 12,646%.   In tracking and handling risk-related funds, MEXC shared suspicious addresses with major industry participants, assisted in identifying fund flows, and supported verification and freezing procedures under established joint-investigation and law-enforcement cooperation procedures.   Over 20,000 Risk-Related Accounts Identified and Restricted, With More Than 600,000 USDT in Misdirected Assets Returned In account risk identification, MEXC identified and restricted 20,752 accounts associated with risk-related activities during the period, an increase of 118.03% from the previous reporting period. The platform identified 5,288 risk groups, up 20.35%. By region of origin, these groups were concentrated primarily in the Commonwealth of Independent States (1,803), Nigeria (1,099), and Indonesia (976).   For user asset recovery, MEXC manually processed 818 applications for the return of misdirected assets, returning the equivalent of 602,225 USDT, an increase of 75.31% from the previous reporting period.   Futures Insurance Fund Reaches 792 Million USDT, Strengthening Protection Against Negative Balance Risk As of September 1, 2026, the total balance of the MEXC Futures Insurance Fund reached 791,696,422 USDT, an increase of 5.44% from the previous reporting period.   The Futures Insurance Fund covers negative balances that may arise during liquidation, providing a risk buffer during extreme market conditions and helping reduce the likelihood of auto-deleveraging (ADL). When a liquidated position is closed at a price better than the bankruptcy price, the remaining funds are credited to the fund. Users can view the real-time balance on the MEXC Proof of Trust page.   Reserve Ratios for Four Major Assets Remain Above 100%, With BTC at Approximately 288% According to the proof of reserves disclosed for this period, MEXC maintained reserve ratios above 100% for four major assets, as follows:   Bitcoin (BTC): reserve ratio of approximately 288%, with total wallet assets of 12,312.75 BTC against 4,282.20 BTC in user assets; Ethereum (ETH): reserve ratio of approximately 113%, with total wallet assets of 66,227.79 ETH; USDT: reserve ratio of approximately 115%, with total wallet assets of approximately 1.940 billion USDT; USDC: reserve ratio of approximately 114%, with total wallet assets of approximately 194.85 million USDC.   The on-chain addresses corresponding to these reserve assets have been disclosed, allowing users to verify through the Merkle Tree whether their individual account balances were included in this proof of reserves.   As an additional layer of user asset protection, the MEXC Guardian Fund maintains a dual-reserve structure of USDT and BTC: USDT provides immediate liquidity support, while BTC serves as a long-term reserve asset across market cycles. MEXC plans to expand the fund from $100 million to $500 million, continuing to strengthen user asset protection. The relevant holding addresses are listed below:   Guardian Fund Wallet Addresses: USDT: 0x469AfE803C54A36674C55231489Cf4b61da8c1bC BTC: 1MDVjZdX8QD212pT8Z8EMP7DuFQHKqN3mx   MEXC CEO Vugar Usi said, “Trust is the true reserve currency of this industry. Protecting user assets means moving decisively the moment risk emerges, while giving users something they can verify for themselves, not just our word for it. We will continue to strengthen our ability to identify and intercept risk-related funds, deepen cooperation across platforms and with law enforcement, and help affected users recover their losses wherever possible. Our bi-monthly security reports are part of that commitment, allowing our security performance to be measured and tracked over time.”   About MEXC Founded in 2018, MEXC is a leading global multi-asset trading platform built as your 0-fee gateway to infinite opportunities. Serving users across 170+ markets, MEXC provides simple and efficient access to crypto, stocks, tokenized assets, derivatives, and a growing range of TradFi-linked opportunities through one account and one gateway.   With 0 trading fees, deep liquidity, broad asset coverage, and a high-performance trading experience, MEXC is designed for retail users who want to discover earlier, act faster, and trade with fewer barriers. As crypto and traditional finance continue to converge, MEXC is committed to making global opportunities more accessible, helping users trade freely and MEXCmize every opportunity.   MEXC Official Website｜ X ｜ Telegram ｜How to Sign Up on MEXC For media inquiries, please contact MEXC PR team: media@mexc.com   Source

title: AI Agent Statistics 2026: Every Number Checked at Its Source
summary: The most-quoted AI agent statistics count intent, and real use in any single department is no more than 10 percent, finds a source-checked analysis by bdautomated 75 figures from 18 publishers traced to the original reports, with who was asked and what counted; the dataset is free to download 15 September 2026. bdautomated today published “AI agent statistics 2026: every number checked at its source”, a free reference page and dataset that traces 75 widely quoted statistics about AI agents and AI use in business back to the documents they came from. The analysis finds that the numbers disagree because they count different things. In McKinsey’s 2025 global survey, 62 percent of organizations were at least experimenting with AI agents, 23 percent had scaled one somewhere in the company, and in any single business function no more than 10 percent had. Surveys that count any adoption or intent report far higher figures: 79 percent of U.S. executives told PwC in April 2025 that agents were already being adopted in their companies, while a Capgemini survey that re-checked what respondents meant by “agent” found 14 percent had implemented one. Across all U.S. businesses of every size, the Census Bureau found 19.8 percent using AI in any business function as of May 2026. The page also decodes the figure that rattled markets in 2025. MIT Project NANDA’s finding that “95 percent of organizations are getting zero return” measured profit-and-loss impact within roughly six months of a pilot, in a sample of 52 interviews, 153 conference survey responses and 300 public deployments, and its authors call the findings preliminary. It does not say that 95 percent of AI projects fail. Gartner’s prediction that over 40 percent of agentic AI projects will be canceled by the end of 2027 is a forecast from June 2025; nobody has counted the cancellations yet. Every figure on the page passed four checks: the number appears in the original document; the exact place and a verbatim quote are recorded; what it measures is written in plain words, including who was asked, how many and when; and it is set against the other sources, with disagreements shown rather than averaged. Market-size forecasts were left out because the reports behind them are paid and cannot be checked. The dataset is published as CSV and JSON under a CC BY 4.0 licence, and the page carries a corrections address. “Two headlines in the same week said almost nobody has AI agents running and almost everybody does, and both were quoting real surveys. We wanted the page we could not find: what each survey actually asked, so a business owner can tell which number is about a company like theirs,” said a spokesperson for bdautomated. The page includes four charts that other publications may embed with attribution, and a table of all 75 figures with their sources, dates, samples and quotes. Read the analysis: https://bdautomated.com/ai-agent-statistics/ checked 2026-09-15 webfetch: “AI Agent Statistics 2026: Every Number Checked at Its Source” Download the data: https://bdautomated.com/data/ai-agent-statistics.csv checked 2026-09-15 webfetch: “id,cat,value,num,stat,counts,src,doc,date,sample,place,quote,url,verdict” About bdautomated bdautomated builds The Book, a named staff of AI agents installed in the accounts a company already runs on. The agents research, prepare, draft, chase and check, each at the level of autonomy the customer sets. bdautomated hosts nothing and stores no customer records. https://bdautomated.com/ Media contact contact@bdautomated.com X- https://x.com/bdautomated
content: A new source-checked analysis published by bdautomated titled 'AI Agent Statistics 2026' examines 75 widely quoted statistics about AI agents in business. The report traces the figures back to original documents from publishers like McKinsey, PwC, Capgemini, and the Census Bureau. The findings reveal that statistics often differ because they measure distinct metrics, such as experimentation, intent, or department adoption, rather than actual broad implementation.

title: Digital Asset Leaders Converge at KBW2026 as Partner Lineup Unveiled
summary: Upbit joins as Presenting Partner, with 0G and BRV confirmed as Official Conference Partners Stable and Tria join as Diamond Sponsors, while BitGo comes on board as Official Institutional Sponsor Kyoungsuk Oh, Michael Heinrich, Brian Mehler, John Lilic and Mike Belshe among featured speakers   Korea Blockchain Week 2026 with Upbit (KBW2026), Asia’s leading digital asset conference, has unveiled its partner lineup, bringing together major players across exchanges, blockchain infrastructure, stablecoins and institutional digital assets. FACTBLOCK, the organizer of KBW2026, announced on August 31 that Upbit, 0G, BRV, Stable, Tria and BitGo will participate as key sponsors of this year’s event. Beyond brand partnerships, CEOs and founders from the participating companies will also take the stage as speakers to discuss some of the most significant shifts shaping the global digital asset industry. Upbit is the Presenting Partner of KBW2026. Kyoungsuk Oh, CEO of Upbit, will also speak at the conference, sharing his perspective on changes in the global digital asset market and the role of Korea. Through its partnership with Upbit, KBW2026 will broaden the conversation around Korea’s digital asset market beyond retail investors to include institutional participation and global financial markets. Decentralized AI infrastructure company 0G and global venture capital firm BRV will participate as the Official Conference Partners. Michael Heinrich, Co-Founder and CEO of 0G Labs, will take the KBW2026 main stage to explore the rise of the agent economy and how decentralized infrastructure is creating a new foundation for AI. 0G is the trust layer for AI, bringing together verifiable compute, private inference, decentralized storage and an AI-native blockchain to power the next generation of AI applications and autonomous agents. BRV will also join as a Conference Partner, further strengthening KBW2026’s global investment and industry network. Global digital asset infrastructure company BitGo will participate as the Official Institutional Sponsor. BitGo Korea, whose strategic shareholders include Hana Financial Group and SK Telecom, recently secured acceptance of its Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) registration from Korea’s Financial Intelligence Unit (KoFIU), establishing a regulatory foundation for its domestic operations. Mike Belshe, Co-Founder and CEO of BitGo, will also speak at KBW2026. Stable and Tria will participate as Diamond Sponsors. title: Stablecoin Push Exposes Infrastructure Readiness Gap at Banks, New RedCompass Labs Research Finds
summary:
Nearly three-quarters (72%) of banks are actively planning, building, piloting or operating capabilities for their own payment stablecoin, but only one in ten banks has those capabilities live in production, according to new research from RedCompass Labs.
The report, “Are banks actually ready for digital money?” surveyed 300 senior payments professionals across Europe, the UK and the US. It examines where digital assets, such as stablecoins, are most likely to gain traction. It asks how banks are preparing and where the main infrastructure, operational and control gaps remain.
For many banks, supporting the rising adoption of stablecoins will require significant change. More than half of respondents (57%) expect their organisation to build new infrastructure or materially upgrade existing systems to support stablecoins or tokenised deposits. 
AI is expected to play a major role in this transition. Most (80%) banks plan to use AI agents to analyse, develop and test upgrades to the systems required to support digital money. 
Banks are also concerned about the commercial consequences of stablecoin adoption. Four in ten (40%) expect deposit outflows over the next three to five years. Nearly three-quarters (72%) expect an average of 8% average of existing payment flows to move onto digital-asset rails. With global cross-border payment flows estimated at $208 trillion in 2025, even a relatively small shift could represent trillions of dollars in payment value.
Banks are also worried about the commercial consequences of failing to support stablecoins or tokenised deposits within the next three years. The biggest concern is the cost of maintaining parallel legacy and digital systems, cited by 26%, followed by deposit outflows to digital-money alternatives at 21%, dependence on third-party infrastructure at 18%, and the loss of corporate payments clients or payment volumes and revenue at 17% each.
Additional notable findings include:
Cross-border settlement is the most likely entry point: Nearly a third (31%) expect cross-border settlement to be their institution’s first interaction with stablecoins.
Regulation and integration are the biggest barriers: Regulatory uncertainty is the leading obstacle to adoption or scale at 35%, followed by integration complexity at 32% and reserve and liquidity concerns at 31%.
The UK is leading the way: Some 20% of UK respondents have their own stablecoin capabilities live in production, while 22% are live with third-party stablecoins, approximately twice the global averages.
Banks are building services beyond issuance: Some 60% are building or already offering treasury, foreign exchange and liquidity services for digital assets. More than half are also developing distribution, embedded payments, on and off ramps, and custody or reserve management.
Santhosh Kumar, Partner and Head of Payments at RedCompass Labs, said: “Banks clearly believe stablecoins are moving into the mainstream, but most are still some distance from being ready to support them at scale. Moving to live payments means reworking the infrastructure, controls, and operations behind the transaction.
“The stakes are commercial too, with banks expecting payment flows to shift onto digital-asset rails, and many are already considering the impact on deposits. AI agents can accelerate the necessary system changes, but banks still need to decide where they want to compete and what they are willing to outsource.
“The banks that turn stablecoin strategy into working infrastructure fastest will be best placed to protect payment flows, deposits, and customer relationships.”

title: Digital Payments Linked to £88 Billion in Additional Sales for UK Businesses, Visa Report Finds
summary:
Modern payment systems have enabled £88bn in additional sales for UK businesses since 2019, according to a new report from Visa and Public First. This is equivalent to around £2,500 per business per year over that period.
The report examines the significant economic impact that digital payments have in the UK and the critical role they play in powering future growth. The research estimates that digital payments contributed £7.5 billion to the UK economy in 2024.
Building on the sizeable impact the sector already has, evidence gathered shows that to reap the benefits of innovation, the UK needs to invest in an environment and regulatory framework that fosters growth, enabling new technology such as stablecoins and AI to scale safely.
By creating this environment, the UK economy could benefit from a further £3.8bn in additional gross value added (GVA) by 2030 from stronger competition and investment within the payments sector. A further £5.1bn a year could be unlocked if more SMEs use digital payments as their front door to wider digital innovation, and could result in £4bn a year in additional economic activity from 2030 through faster AI adoption across payment technologies.
Trust as an economic multiplier
Trust and security are also central to unlocking this growth. The report finds that secure payments give consumers the confidence to spend and businesses the confidence to embrace new technology, while fraud can quickly undermine that momentum.
For businesses, 79% of those surveyed say secure payments are central to wider technology adoption, reinforcing the role that trust plays in enabling continued digital transformation. At the same time, the report estimates that 455,000 businesses may have paused the adoption of new digital technology because of fraud, demonstrating how fraud can stall investment and innovation. 
For consumers, the impact of fraud extends beyond the immediate financial loss. The research estimates that fraud leads to £16bn in lost consumer spending each year, with spending falling by 35.1% for six months following a fraud event. This demonstrates how protecting trust in payments can support continued consumer confidence and economic activity.
However, if the regulatory environment does not continue to support innovation and investment, the UK risks losing both momentum and first-mover advantage to innovation-focused global competitors.

“The UK has built one of the world’s most advanced digital payments economies, but the biggest opportunity is still ahead of us. This report shows the scale of the potential: billions of pounds in additional growth could be unlocked by helping more businesses digitise, accelerating technologies like AI and creating the conditions for continued investment and innovation,” said Rob Cameron, Group Country Manager, UK & Ireland at Visa.
“Digital payments are the invisible infrastructure behind the UK economy, and that only works if people trust it completely. Trust is hard-won and easy to lose. Visa has invested £8bn globally in payments resilience over the past five years because trust is fundamental to that growth. Every fraud event costs momentum: consumers spend less, businesses hesitate to invest and digital transformation stalls. Get that balance right, and payments can be an even more powerful engine for growth.”
Neil Ross, Partner at Public First said: “The UK has been a world leader on payments and payments technology, and our research points to real opportunities to further build on that success. There's growing scope for industry, Government and regulators to work together, quickening the pace of innovation so the UK stays ahead as competition from emerging markets continues to grow."
Taken together, the findings show that the UK’s next phase of payments-led growth may depend on continued innovation and investment, and on maintaining the trust, security and resilience that give consumers and businesses the confidence to adopt new technologies.

title: Experian Take the Guesswork Out of Credit Applications With Fast Track Pre-Approvals
summary:
Experian today launches Fast Track, a lending innovation designed to transform the pre-approval journey for both consumers and lenders.
Powered by enhanced data insights, including Open Banking and advanced affordability information, Fast Track helps people better understand their likelihood of approval before applying for products such as loans and credit cards.
People can apply with greater confidence that they will be accepted for a pre-approved offer, face fewer additional checks, and avoid the disappointment of receiving a revised offer - or being declined - later in the application process. For lenders, Fast Track helps reduce unnecessary manual reviews, increase application completion rates and minimise applications that are unlikely to be approved.
Previously, people who received a pre-approved marketplace offer for a credit product were still subject to additional affordability and verification checks once they entered the lender’s application journey. This could result in declines, revised offers, requests for further documentation and longer application times.
Fast Track helps address this challenge by analysing a wider range of income, affordability and identity data at an earlier stage. As a result, lenders can complete more verification and affordability checks upfront, giving borrowers more certainty, saving them time and reducing the risk of disappointment later in the process.
Key partner in the project and early adopter, Lendable, has brought Fast Track to its loan customers, and in testing saw significantly fewer people who were told they were pre-approved stopped during final checks, with a 50% reduction in verification issues. Other lenders are already using Fast Track to improve the customer journey.
Edu Castro, Managing Director, Experian Consumer Services UK&I, said: “Consumers want greater certainty when they search for credit, and lenders want to spend less time processing applications which don’t end-up being approved. Fast Track is designed to address both challenges.
“By combining traditional eligibility assessments with richer affordability and Open Banking insights, we're helping consumers access more relevant offers with greater confidence, while enabling lenders to streamline application journeys and improve conversion. It's an important step forward in creating a more efficient lending experience for everyone."
Chris Meurice, Managing Director at Lendable said: “Lendable was founded to help people get credit and save money, with transparency and accuracy comparing offers the foundations of a better deal.
“We have worked with Experian since 2018 to drive the vast improvement that pre-approved offers brought, but we knew that even more could be done to improve the customer experience. Fast Track is the missing link. It brings a new level of confidence for consumers, using the latest advancements in credit technology to remove last-minute rejections and ensure people pay only what they expect.”

title: Marloo Launches Ask Marloo to Introduce Significant Efficiencies to Advisers’ Workflow
summary:
Marloo, the AI platform designed specifically for financial advisers, today launches Ask Marloo, a powerful new tool accessible to all the firm’s adviser clients.  Ask Marloo lets advisers work across their entire client book at once, instead of one file at a time. It also helps advisers take on a colleague's clients when that adviser moves on or retires.
This new feature is hosted on a refreshed home screen which pinpoints items for immediate attention and provides an update on tasks in progress. It enables advisers to conduct a deep dive across all clients, surfacing insights which can be converted to build their book value. Ask Marloo’s capabilities include:
Highlighting which clients may be affected by market developments such as changes to interest rates and to what extent these impact their financial standing.
Alerting advisers to clients who have mentioned an upcoming change to their financial circumstances but have not yet sought further advice.
Detailing key objectives and requirements across a book of new or legacy clients inherited when a colleague moves on.
Identifying clients with adult children or dependents that advisers have not yet engaged with, but who might benefit from financial advice.
Pinpointing clients whose cover is due to be renewed.
While this information is stored within an adviser’s CRM it is frequently spread across multiple tools and requires digging to extract. Ask Marloo addresses this by drawing on meeting notes, documents and emails to pull out key data essential for advisers and paraplanners to deliver timely advice quickly and efficiently.
Hardy Michel Co-Founder at Marloo, said, “Financial advice runs on memory: what was said three years ago, why each decision was made, and what has changed since. That is not a nice touch on top of the advice, it is the foundation of a client relationship. However, one person can only remember so much.
“Essential background information on a client is scattered, and it is time-consuming for advisers to piece it together across multiple tabs. Ask Marloo changes that by recalling what is important to a client, demonstrating the potential growth opportunities within a client book and ensuring advisers continue to add value through the service they provide.
